deviations.from: Syllabus wording: hydrophobic interactions listed among the types of bonding that hold a protein in shape
deviations.to: Taught as hydrophobic interactions, with a sentence saying they are not bonds (no shared electrons, no opposite charges), while still teaching them under objective 03
deviations.why: Biologically they are a clustering of non-polar R groups driven by water, not a bond; the syllabus groups them with bonds so the notes keep the syllabus coverage and state the difference.

deviations.from: Objective 06 'carry out biuret test' with no stated limit on what gives a positive result
deviations.to: Claim states a positive result needs a chain with at least two peptide bonds; single amino acids give no violet colour
deviations.why: This is the standard chemistry of the test and separates protein from amino acids; marked single_source in the claim notes.

deviations.from: Slot 014-MECH covers 'explain that water is a polar molecule and how hydrogen bonding occurs' in one 2-mark card
deviations.to: 014-MECH asks how polarity leads to hydrogen bonds; 013-DEF carries polar molecule; the cause of polarity (electronegativity) is taught in the notes and claim 020
deviations.why: Both halves of the objective cannot be marked fairly in 2 marks on one card; the labels (subtype, AO, command word, tariff) are unchanged.

deviations.from: Slot 018-MISCON (haemoglobin molecule versus red blood cell, or 'an ion' for the iron)
deviations.to: One card with two linked parts of the error (cell instead of molecule; iron named only as an ion), the second part stated in the prompt
deviations.why: The register entry records both slips in one finding, so the discrimination keeps them together within the 2-mark tariff.

deviations.from: P01 and P02 objective choice 'choose 2-4 objectives'
deviations.to: P01 uses objectives 01, 03, 07 and 08; P02 uses 04, 05 and 06
deviations.why: Together the two tasks exercise the six objectives not already covered at length by the flashcards; objective 02 is practised by four flashcards and is left out of the sets to stay within four objectives each.
